entity_types.business: The source's business/legal-person subject; legal form remains unknown unless stated.
entity_types.licence: An authorisation held by a business.
entity_types.establishment: A physical operating facility, separate from its operator.
entity_types.charity: A registered charity lodging an Annual Information Statement with the ACNC, identified by its ABN; its legal form is not inferred from its name.
entity_types.fundraising_authorisation: A state or territory fundraising registration/licence number held by a charity, evidenced by a fundraising number column for that jurisdiction.

ext.entity.former_name.definition: A legal name the business held before its current one. Use valid_from/valid_to paths when the source dates the name. Never a trading name.

ext.entity.legal_form.definition: Registrar's company type, decoded through a crosswalk table. Unknown codes -> unknown.

ext.entity.legal_form_detail.definition: Finer legal structure stated by the registrar (limited by shares/guarantee, listed, superannuation trustee, non-profit). Value is "CODE: label" from a crosswalk table.

ext.entity.status_detail.definition: The registrar's full status code and label ("EXAD: External administration"). The core entity.status enum stays coarse; distress codes live here.

ext.entity.date_established.definition: Founding / establishment date. Not a registration date.

ext.entity.sector_tag.definition: A source-stated activity or beneficiary tag, e.g. scheme acnc_purpose or acnc_beneficiary. Keep the publisher's wording.

ext.entity.industry_code.definition: ANZSIC 2006 division letter, subdivision, group or class, produced only through a reviewed crosswalk table from a source-stated activity (trade class, licence category, purpose). The raw source value is kept in raw_value. scheme = anzsic2006.

ext.entity.operating_region.definition: Where the business says it operates (service footprint), not where it is registered.

ext.entity.operating_country.definition: Country the business says it operates in, as the source writes it (one per observation).

ext.entity.tax_concession.definition: Tax-concession status stated by the regulator (Public Benevolent Institution, Health Promotion Charity).

ext.entity.responsible_persons.definition: Number of responsible persons (board size) the regulator reports.

ext.entity.financial_year_end.definition: Reporting-cycle end as dd-Mon (e.g. 30-Jun). Used to schedule refreshes.

ext.entity.prior_registration_state.definition: State of original incorporation before national registration. Not an address.

ext.entity.address_point.definition: lat,lon of the business's OWN stated address (e.g. a licensee's business address). A premises or site location is ext.establishment.geo on an establishment role instead.

ext.entity.holder_kind.definition: Whether the source says the record's holder is a natural person or an organisation. This is matching evidence. It never implies sole_trader.

ext.financial.total_income.definition: Total income as published for a stated reporting period. A fact for a period, not a current attribute.

ext.financial.taxable_income.definition: Taxable income for the period. Missing is not zero.

ext.financial.revenue_band.definition: A revenue/turnover band from a named scheme (acnc_size_2022, qbcc_mfr). The value must be a label of that scheme's crosswalk table; band thresholds live in the table, not in the claim.

ext.licence.number.definition: Publisher-assigned licence number. Identifies the licence across snapshots.

ext.licence.class.definition: Licence class / licensed trade in the publisher's wording.

ext.licence.category.definition: Licence category in the publisher's wording.

ext.licence.authorisation.definition: One authorised activity per observation (split the publisher's list).

ext.licence.authorisation_text.definition: Complete publisher authorisation text, including headings and conditions. Unparsed source evidence, not independent permission claims.

ext.licence.start_date.definition: Publisher-stated commencement of the licence, not the business establishment or registration date.

ext.licence.end_date.definition: Publisher-stated end of the licence, not the end of the business or all its claims.

ext.licence.status.definition: Licence status as published (licence status, not company status).

ext.licence.condition.definition: Licence condition such as trading hours.

ext.licence.status_event.definition: A dated status-history entry (e.g. a contravention of a licence condition).

ext.licence.related_licence_number.definition: Number of another licence the same holder holds (e.g. an AFS licence number). 0 / blank = none.

ext.establishment.source_key.definition: Publisher's site code. Identifies the site across snapshots.

ext.establishment.geo.definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

ext.establishment.region.definition: Publisher's region (licensing region, metro/regional, employment services area).

ext.establishment.capacity.definition: Published maximum patron count or similar capacity.

ext.establishment.program.definition: Government programme or contract code delivered at this site.

ext.contact.phone.definition: Phone number normalised to E.164 (+61...). Numbers shorter than 8 digits or without an area code are rejected. Mobiles are personal data unless published as a business line.

ext.contact.email_domain.definition: The domain of a published email address. Personal local parts are never stored.

ext.contact.role_email.definition: A role mailbox (info@, enquiries@, admin@ ...). Personal mailboxes are dropped by the transform.

ext.contact.website_domain.definition: Registrable host of a published website (www. removed).

entity.legal_name.definition: As registered. Not the trading name.

entity.trading_name.definition: May be multiple. Emit one observation each.

entity.abn.definition: Australian Business Number. Has a checksum — validate it, do not just length-check.

entity.acn.definition: Australian Company Number. Also checksummed. The last 9 digits of an ABN are often the ACN, but not always.

entity.nzbn.definition: New Zealand Business Number, if you happen to hit an NZ source.

entity.entity_type.definition: Default to unknown. Guessing here causes downstream harm.

entity.industry_code.definition: ANZSIC where available. Record the raw source value too.

observation.source_id.definition: Stable identifier for the dataset the claim came from.

observation.source_record_id.definition: Must be traceable back to the exact raw record. If the source has no key, construct a deterministic one and document how.

observation.ingested_at.definition: When you read it. These are different and both matter.

observation.valid_from.definition: When the claim became true in the world, if the source says.

observation.valid_to.definition: Null means still current as far as this source knows.

observation.licence.definition: From the dataset metadata. CKAN exposes it. If a source has no clear licence, that is a finding, not a blocker — record 'unknown' and flag it.

observation.extractor_version.definition: Which version of your mapping config and engine produced this. You will be glad of it later.

confidence.source_reliability.definition: How much do we trust this publisher on this kind of claim.

confidence.field_confidence.definition: How sure are we that we mapped and parsed this field correctly.

confidence.link_confidence.definition: How sure are we that this record refers to that entity. Only on links.

dyn.charity.registration_status.definition: The ACNC registration status of the charity as published in the Annual Information Statement, including revocation reasons such as voluntary revocation or double defaulter. This is a charity-regulator status, not a company legal status or a licence status.
values: Voluntarily Revoked Not Entitled To Be A Charity
dyn.charity.registration_status.why_not_existing: entity.status is a coarse company-lifecycle enum (active/deregistered/in_liquidation/suspended/unknown) owned by business; ACNC charity registration states carry regulator-specific revocation reasons and belong to the charity role, so reuse would change meaning and owner. ext.licence.status is a licence status, not charity registration.

dyn.charity.basic_religious_charity.definition: Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity is a basic religious charity for the reporting year, recorded as y/n in the source.
dyn.charity.basic_religious_charity.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers ACNC basic religious charity classification; ext.entity.tax_concession covers PBI/HPC/DGR concessions, a different regulatory attribute.

dyn.charity.incorporated_association.definition: Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity is an incorporated association, recorded as y/n. This is a self-reported association attribute, not an inference of legal form from the charity name.
dyn.charity.incorporated_association.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept records incorporated-association status; entity legal form is not otherwise modelled and must not be inferred from names.

dyn.charity.state_association_number.definition: State or territory incorporated-association registration number held by the charity, qualified by the jurisdiction whose association-number column supplied it. Values are publisher-formatted strings (e.g. INC9886754, A0005374L) and are not normalised across states.
dyn.charity.state_association_number.why_not_existing: ext.entity.prior_registration_number is a single legacy state registration number with no jurisdiction qualifier and no multi-value scope; the ACNC file holds up to eight jurisdiction-specific association numbers per charity, so reuse would lose the jurisdiction and multiplicity. ext.entity.prior_registration_state is a state name, not a number.

dyn.charity.conducted_activities.definition: Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity conducted any activities during its reporting period, recorded as y/n. A 'n' answer is accompanied by a free-text reason in a separate field and is not evidence the charity is inactive or deregistered.
dyn.charity.conducted_activities.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept records whether a charity conducted activities in its reporting period; dyn.charity.registration_status is a regulator status and ext.entity.sector_tag is an activity tag, so reuse would change meaning and owner.

dyn.charity.no_activity_reason.definition: Free-text explanation supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for why it did not conduct activities during the reporting period. Publisher wording is retained verbatim; it is self-reported narrative, not a regulator finding.
source_paths: why charity did not conduct activities
dyn.charity.no_activity_reason.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds charity self-reported narrative reasons for inactivity; ext.licence.authorisation_text is licence authorisation text owned by the licence role, so reuse would change meaning and owner.

dyn.charity.purposes_pursued_description.definition: Free-text description supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement of how it pursued its charitable purposes during the reporting period. Self-reported narrative retained verbatim, not a regulator classification or an ANZSIC activity code.
dyn.charity.purposes_pursued_description.why_not_existing: ext.entity.sector_tag is a short source-stated tag with a scheme qualifier, not a full narrative description of how purposes were pursued; ext.entity.industry_code is a reviewed crosswalk code. Reuse would change meaning and granularity.

dyn.charity.international_activity_opera.definition: Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity undertook international activities by operating overseas including programs during the reporting period, recorded as y/n.
source_paths: international activities undertaken - operating overseas including programs
dyn.charity.international_activity_opera.why_not_existing: ext.entity.operating_region and ext.entity.operating_country describe where a business says it operates, not a charity's self-reported international-activity flag; reuse would change owner, meaning and units (region/country values versus y/n).

dyn.charity.international_activity_trans.definition: Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity undertook international activities by transferring goods or services overseas during the reporting period, recorded as y/n.
source_paths: international activities undertaken - transferring goods or services overseas
dyn.charity.international_activity_trans.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept captures a charity's self-reported goods/services transfer overseas flag; ext.entity.operating_country is a country value owned by business, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units.

dyn.charity.international_activity_other.definition: Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity undertook other international activities not covered by the operating-overseas or goods/services-transfer categories during the reporting period, recorded as y/n.
dyn.charity.international_activity_other.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers a residual 'other international activities' flag for a charity; the existing operating-region/country concepts are business-owned location values, not y/n activity flags.

dyn.charity.international_activity_detai.definition: Free-text description supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement of the international activities it undertook during the reporting period. Self-reported narrative retained verbatim; it does not by itself establish a country of operation.
dyn.charity.international_activity_detai.why_not_existing: ext.entity.operating_country is a single country value owned by business; this is charity-owned free-text narrative that may mention several places without being a structured country claim, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units.

dyn.charity.other_international_activity.definition: Free-text description supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement of the 'other' international activities it undertook during the reporting period. Self-reported narrative retained verbatim.
dyn.charity.other_international_activity.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds charity-owned free-text describing residual international activities; ext.entity.operating_country is a structured business-owned country value, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units.

dyn.fundraising_authorisation.number.definition: Publisher-assigned fundraising registration or licence number held by a charity for a specific Australian state or territory, taken verbatim from that jurisdiction's fundraising-number column. Formats differ by jurisdiction (e.g. CH2136, CCP2996, C/10450, FR0017060, CFN/26748) and are not normalised across states; a placeholder value such as 00000 is retained as published and is not evidence of a valid registration.
dyn.fundraising_authorisation.number.why_not_existing: ext.licence.number is owned by the licence role and identifies a business-held licence; a state fundraising registration is owned by the fundraising_authorisation role and is jurisdiction-qualified, so reuse would change owner and meaning. dyn.charity.state_association_number is an incorporated-association number, a different registration regime, and is owned by charity.

dyn.fundraising_authorisation.activity_f.definition: Publisher-recorded y/n flag from the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity reported fundraising activity in a given jurisdiction or online, qualified by the jurisdiction (or 'online' for the national online-fundraising column). A 'y' flag is a self-reported activity indicator and does not by itself prove a registration number exists.
dyn.fundraising_authorisation.activity_f.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept records a charity's per-jurisdiction or online fundraising activity flag; ext.licence.authorisation is licence-owned authorisation text, and address.state is a business address state, so reuse would change owner, meaning and units.

dyn.charity.staff_headcount.definition: Number of people the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement as staff of a given employment category (full time, part time or casual) for its own reporting period. A headcount of people, not full-time-equivalent staff and not a monetary amount; a reported zero is retained as published and is not evidence of no activity.
dyn.charity.staff_headcount.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept records charity staff headcounts; ext.financial.total_income is a monetary business-owned measure and employee expenses is a money amount, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units. The three columns share one meaning (people per employment category) and differ only by category, so one concept with an employment_category qualifier avoids needless aliases.

dyn.charity.volunteer_count.definition: Number of volunteers the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own reporting period. A count of volunteers, distinct from paid staff headcount and from full-time-equivalent staff; a reported zero is retained as published.
dyn.charity.volunteer_count.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers volunteer numbers; dyn.charity.staff_headcount (proposed) covers paid staff by employment category, and volunteers are unpaid and reported in a separate column, so folding them in would change meaning.

dyn.charity.full_time_equivalent_staff.definition: Total full-time-equivalent staff the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own reporting period, expressed as an FTE number of persons (decimal, e.g. 4.14). This is a workload-equivalent measure, not a headcount and not a monetary amount.
dyn.charity.full_time_equivalent_staff.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds an FTE measure; dyn.charity.staff_headcount (proposed) counts people per employment category and cannot represent fractional FTE, so reuse would change units and meaning.

HOLDS_FUNDRAISING_AUTHORISATION.definition: Charity holds a state or territory fundraising registration evidenced by a fundraising number column for that jurisdiction.
